name: scaffold-workspace
description: 元搭 · 低代码平台前端工作区：宿主 app（scaffold-vue）与组件物料包（packages/scaffold-ui）

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm --workspace scaffold-vue run bundle
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace @scaffold/ui run typecheck && npm --workspace scaffold-vue run typecheck
scripts.test:unit: npm --workspace @scaffold/ui run test:unit && npm --workspace scaffold-vue run test:unit
